subject: general
question: The HCF and LCM of two numbers are 3 and 396, respectively. If one of the numbers is 132, find the other one.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Product of **HCF** and **LCM** = Product of the **two numbers**.

3 × 396 = 132 × **Other Number**

**Other Number** = (3 × 396) ÷ 132

**Other Number** = 3 × 3 = 9

**∴ The correct answer is 9.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**HCF** = 3

**LCM** = 396

**First Number (n₁)** = 132

**Formula Used:**

**HCF** × **LCM** = **n₁** × **n₂**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c00472ef48cf69e0c4c46d59f30de1df8d098c614ae4d0af6b07514243e7814f.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ 3 × 396 = 132 × **n₂**

⇒ 1188 = 132 × **n₂**

⇒ **n₂** = 1188 ÷ 132

⇒ **n₂** = 9

**∴ The correct answer is 9.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

HCF (Highest Common Factor)

The greatest number which divides each of the two or more given numbers exactly.

LCM (Least Common Multiple)

The smallest number which is exactly divisible by each of the given numbers.

HCF of Fractions

**HCF** of Numerators ÷ **LCM** of Denominators.

Co-prime Numbers

Two numbers are **co-prime** if their **HCF** is 1.</p
